verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has AI-driven anomaly-related features (Intuit Intelligence chat can 'help resolve anomalies', reconciliation discrepancy reports, Payroll AI spotting inconsistencies) and an official MCP server exposing 145 tools/CRUD across entities that would let an external agent poll ledger data, but there is no documented feature that continuously monitors the ledger, specifically flags duplicate transactions, or runs as a pre-close audit agent. Missing for 10: dedicated duplicate-transaction detection, an autonomous 'monitor before close' workflow, and evidence of end-to-end agent automation rather than manual chat queries or third-party MCP tool assembly.
